purpose: Targeted offline verification of the five current paper evidence axes without model, API, benchmark solver, native evaluator, VM, request-body, response-body, credential, or evaluator-answer access.

environment.pytest_unavailable_interpretation: The default Python environment did not contain pytest. This was a runner-availability result, not a test failure. Unittest modules were run with the standard library; the one pytest-style common-40 contract file was checked with an equivalent read-only assertion harness.

unittest_run.command: PYTHONPATH=scripts:. python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_evaluate_tsp_constraint_confirmation tests.test_or_debug_confirmation_inference tests.test_mixed_skill_router tests.test_mixed_skill_execution tests.test_audit_mixed_skill_confirmation tests.test_prepare_mixed_skill_confirmation_bundle tests.test_typed_count_repair_certificate tests.test_certify_typed_count_repair

coverage: three repeats remain 40 distinct problems and 120 planned runs
infrastructure-unavailable outcomes remain in the primary denominator
six invalid denominator or count combinations fail closed
three invalid family allocations fail closed

tsp: unfrozen or wrong-role plan rejection before file access
or_debug: one-shot group-effect reporting without inventing a pass/fail gate
observed-regression handling without a zero-event bound
mixed_router: unsafe path and content-hash rejection before dispatch
outer identifier exclusion from guard features
missing, duplicate, malformed, source-mismatched, route-mismatched and output-mismatched record accounting
public bundle excludes hidden and evaluator fields
typed_count_repair: distinct one-field semantic and resource failure modes
nonempty and empty version-space termination bounds
answer-free projection binding without authored upper-bound hash

limitations: This record verifies targeted contract and reconstruction tests, not the full historical repository test suite.
It does not rerun TSP, OR-Debug, mixed-routing solvers or external baseline inference.
It does not independently establish benchmark accuracy; headline accuracy remains bound to the terminal result artifacts and their closures.

The equivalent common-40 harness mirrors the pytest-style assertions because pytest is absent from the default Python environment; it does not replace execution of the complete summary script against all private or locally provisioned artifacts.
